podcast.title: Early 2000s Emo Peak
podcast.body: Story of the Year was a prominent band during Emo's peak in the early 2000s, alongside Dashboard Confessional, Saves the Day, Thursday, Taking Back Sunday, and My Chemical Romance. By the early 2010s, however, emo began to wane, leading to a perceived pause before its mid-decade revival. "It had its moments early in the century with bands like Dashboard Conventional and saves the day, Thursday, store the year, taking back Sunday and my chemical romance."
